obsidian-canvas.$description: Obsidian Canvas — Page background, dominant surface — near-black with a whisper of warmth, the default stage for all content

void.$description: Void — Deepest surface layer for hero gradients, modal backdrops, and borders that need to disappear into the canvas

charcoal-card.$description: Charcoal Card — Elevated card and panel surfaces sitting one step above the canvas

slate-edge.$description: Slate Edge — Hairline borders and dividers on dark surfaces

iron-veil.$description: Iron Veil — Muted backgrounds for tags, list-item fills, and disabled state washes

smoke.$description: Smoke — Icon strokes, secondary text, and inactive controls — the workhorse mid-gray

ash.$description: Ash — Tertiary text and subtle body borders in content-heavy lists

frost.$description: Frost — Light-mode borders, input fields, and secondary CTA borders

linen.$description: Linen — Light-mode surface tint and subtle section dividers in white backgrounds

snow.$description: Snow — Hairline borders, dividers, input outlines, and card edges on light surfaces. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

electric-iris.$description: Electric Iris — Primary action background, active nav indicator, hero aurora cool stop — vivid violet-blue against charcoal reads as switched-on, not corporate

ember-pulse.$description: Ember Pulse — Secondary accent, hero aurora warm stop, notification dot, illustration highlight — the amber that breaks the blue's composure and gives the beam its heat

molasses.$description: Molasses — Deep ember tone for dark-context borders, icon strokes, and tag fills when coral would be too bright

inter.$description: All functional UI text — body, nav, buttons, list items, captions, small headings. Used at weight 500–600 for emphasis, 400 for body, 300 sparingly for quiet metadata.

esbuild.$description: Display-only: hero headlines, section openers, MetaBrain feature titles. The condensed geometry and tight tracking make 84px feel editorial rather than SaaS. Never used below 28px.
